operations.name: Lawrence H. Mathews

expected.convicted: Disposition not documented in the available sources.

operations.research_note: Charleston Mercury April 18, 1861, Montgomery correspondence datelined April 15: Mathews, Pensacola Observer correspondent signing Nemo, arrested yesterday and sent under guard to Montgomery, examined at War Department. Thus April 14 arrest and continuous guarded custody. April 23 Mercury correspondence datelined April 17 identifies L. H. Mathews, same paper/pseudonym, honorably acquitted of furnishing information to enemy through reporting anticipated Fort Pickens attack. Acquittal not used as physical release. Existing biography links Fort Delaware series; no Fort Delaware admission inferred and biography/notes preserved.
